title: Design: Open internal work order estimate carries the INTERNAL stamp
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer and asset, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost (for example $95.00), the line In Progress, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-12-04-work-order-finance-tab.png, iwo-happy-15-15-finance-tab.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the internal work order.
  2. Click the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The estimate carries the INTERNAL stamp with "Category: General Internal" under it (the design version).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S2-R4: “The estimate and invoice documents for these work orders show the same and carry the NO CHARGE stamp and, on a no-charge work order, the line "Category: [Category]" under the stamp; the shop-floor Print Work Order is unchanged (it carries no prices today).”
  • S3-R5: “The Finance tab of a closed work order shows the NO CHARGE document: the masthead as on the invoice today (letterhead left, the shop logo in the centre slot, the document block "Internal Work Order [number]" or "No Charge Work Order [number]" with the date right), and under the masthead line, on the left and never over the logo, the INTERNAL or NO CHARGE stamp with the line "Category: [name]" and, when set, "· Original work order [number]" (a link in ShopView, plain on the PDF), Bill to the customer, the asset block, labor lines with hours only, parts lines with quantity and cost only (cost under 'See Financial Data'), a Summary with Parts cost (one number: stock parts plus special orders and sublet, at the amounts of S3-R2, core cost excluded, S2-E7), Shop supplies (when above $0.00) and Labor hours (the labor hours on the lines), and no tax, total, payments, balance or signature block; with Download, Print and Email (the recipient field is empty; the user types the shop's own address or any other; never automatically).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
